summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing its interim results for H1 2026. The filing reports strong financial performance including attributable profit of £3.0 billion, Return on Tangible Equity of 19.7%, and earnings per share of 38.1 pence. It notes the completion of the Evelyn Partners acquisition and announces an interim dividend of 12.0p per share, with share buybacks to be considered from full year 2026. This is a routine periodic earnings report, not a special-situation event.
